correctness.rationale: An h-signature records the atom values and a join of outgoing weights in each (h−1)-signature fiber. Filtering by a Boolean characteristic formula for a fiber recovers its join with diamond, and finite distributivity and the Heyting adjunction give the stated aggregation for both modalities even with infinitely many successors. Independent tree realizations give every signature and show truncation is onto. Any realization needs one state per type and at least one outgoing pair for each positive coordinate per source. On the type-labelled frame, each arbitrary rowwise choice of a single target in the prescribed truncation fiber makes the actual projected signatures agree by induction, including when loops are selected. Counting the positive slots over all types gives E_h; equality forces one edge of the prescribed weight in each nonzero fiber. The stated sample counts agree. `python3 /workspace/branches/independent_replay.py 1` reconstructed the types and edge counts with independently varied representatives for four cases, including depth two and the four-element Boolean algebra; it is finite corroboration only.
